[h1]SlipBreak™ 0.0.1 Ver. "Nature"[/h1] 

The first Major Update during the Closest Major Update Cycle 0.0.1 Through 0.0.9
0.0.1 Includes a wide variety of updates to the overall gameplay loop

[h3]- MOCAP Movement System and Parkour
- Dynamic Health, Stamina, Endurance Bar
- Combo System, Enemy Hit Reactions, Dynamic Enemy Health Bars
- Custom Reallusion Asset for Aurora, Custom Reallusion IDLE
- Typewriting Effect before load screen, New Game Cinematic
- UI Overhaul[/h3]

Moving forward we will focus on getting to 0.0.2 Stable, with constant updates on X, and minor updates on Steamworks
